---
title: "cloneref"
sidebarTitle: "cloneref"
description: "Pushes a new Instance reference for the same same underlying Instance and returns it."
keywords: ["cloneref","Cache","clonereference"]
---

<div className="real-function-page">

```lua
cloneref(instance: Instance): Instance
```

## Aliases

- `clonereference`

## Arguments

<ParamField path={"instance"} type={"Instance"} required>
Instance object used as the source for the new reference.
</ParamField>

## Returns

<ResponseField name={"reference"} type={"Instance"}>
Instance reference returned after Instance cache runs with the original Instance reference.
</ResponseField>

## Example

Create another Instance reference from an existing Instance userdata.

```lua
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local reference = cloneref(Players)
print(reference)

local sameAlias = clonereference(Players)
print(sameAlias)
```


</div>
